in_sanskrit.name: शर्वरीत्

in_marathi.name: Sharvrit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvrit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rules over the gods, a name derived from the Sanskrit term 'sharva' meaning 'lord, master, ruler' and 'rit' meaning 'ruler, sovereign'. This name is a powerful one, evoking images of strength, courage, and leadership. It is a name for those who are destined to lead and rule, and who possess the strength and courage to do so.
